title: Water service provision in rapidly urbanising villages: a comparison of rural and urban governance in Mumbai and Chennai regions in India
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,1135-1153
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00935A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Renjitha Maniyil Haridasan, Alison Parker, May Sule
Through a comparison of water services in urbanising villages under rural governance and towns under urban governance, this study demonstrates that a shift to urban administrative status alone is insufficient to deliver improved water services.
